ocl.precondition: LoanTerm.allInstance()->select(o | o.ItemID = itemid and o.Content = content)->isEmpty() = true
ocl.postcondition: let loanTerm:LoanTerm in loanTerm.oclIsNew() and LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(loanTerm) and loanTerm.ItemID = itemid and loanTerm.Content = content and result = true
